Good morning! **Swin** here. The Oscars aired last night. I'll admit I didn't
watch all of it, but host **Conan O 'Brien** had this to say: "Welcome back,
we're coming to you live from the 'Has a Small Penis Theatre.' Let's see
[Donald Trump] [put his name in front of
that](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3_h2uRk3bjI)!" Around 10pm ET Sunday, I
emailed the White House for comment, given how much Trump and his senior staff
like to [respond to such celebrity ongoings](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-white-
house-sabrina-carpenter), or to [jabs at his
manhood](https://www.rollingstone.com/politics/politics-news/stephanie-
grisham-book-trump-defends-penis-cats-show-tunes-1233647/). I'll let you know
if or when I hear back. 🙂

In today's '**First Draft** ,' Trump would really, _really_ like some other
countries' assistance in fixing the global crisis he started, the US
president's economic adviser thinks you'll believe ANYTHING, and **Javier
Bardem** uses his moment at the Oscars to say, "Free Palestine."

# Where Did All Our Friends Go?

Over the weekend, Donald Trump and top US officials spent much of their time
begging American allies (and also Trump's [good pal
Xi](https://www.thedailybeast.com/trump-couldnt-give-a-shit-about-china-
rounding-up-millions-of-uighur-muslims/) in China) to bail him out of the
economic fiasco he created with his illegal war.

The amount of begging was jarring and unbecoming, [even for
them](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-white-house-address-speech-primetime).

Since the start of the US-Israeli war late last month, the Iranian government
has been firing on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, and reportedly laying
[mines](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/12/world/middleeast/iran-mines-strait-
of-hormuz-us.html), shutting down the narrow and crucial waterway. As a
result, an oil, gas, and fertilizer crisis is rapidly unfolding.

This was all entirely predictable. President Trump [was warned in
advance](https://zeteo.com/p/us-intel-trump-iran-regime-first-draft) that Iran
would likely [respond this way](https://www.wsj.com/politics/national-
security/iran-oil-hormuz-blockade-trump-f96bdd53). He went ahead with his war.
Trump's escalations haven't led Iran to back down, so he and his team have
decided to plead with other countries to help the US clear the strait.

Trump
[claimed](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/116227904143399817)
Saturday that **" many countries"** would be sending **" War Ships**" to
reopen the Strait, before adding with less certainty: **" Hopefully China,
France, Japan, South Korea, the UK, and others, that are affected by this
artificial constraint, will send Ships to the area."**

On Sunday, Trump's energy secretary, Chris Wright, went on 'Meet the Press' to
[feign](https://bsky.app/profile/atrupar.com/post/3mh43pdyxrs2q) solidarity
with all nations - and to implore China to fix everything. **" We care first
about Americans, but Americans live in a globalized world, so we care about
all the nations,"** he said, adding, **" I do expect China will be a
constructive partner in reopening the Strait of Hormuz."**

Trump's UN ambassador Mike Waltz
[told](https://www.cnn.com/audio/podcasts/state-of-the-union-with-jake-
tapper/episodes/f733a2dc-b5a8-11f0-968c-7fb04db2f210) CNN on Sunday the
president and his lieutenants **" welcome, encourage, and even demand [other
nations'] participation to help their own economies."**

Like any common schoolyard bully, Trump is now vacillating between self-
pitying and threatening to take his ball and go home.
